en-US.name: Matt Pocock Skills
en-US.summary: Matt Pocock's collection of small, composable engineering skills for real application development across any model. Some workflows require host subagents, Git and a separately authorized issue tracker.

zh-CN.summary: Matt Pocock 的真实工程 AI Skill 合集，小巧、易改、可组合，适配任意模型做实际开发而非 vibe coding。部分流程需要宿主支持子 Agent、Git 和另行授权的任务跟踪工具。

requirements.value: The implement-spec workflow requires host support for subagents and Git worktrees/branches. Other workflows use the issue tracker selected by the operator (GitHub, Linear or local files). No tracker account or host capability is provided by this listing.

The operator authorizes access and writes to the chosen issue tracker. Manual-only upstream skills retain their explicit invocation requirement; stop and explain when a required host capability is unavailable.
